user.title: Add Hive receiver
user.description: How is the receiver connected to Home Assistant?

z2m.title: Zigbee2MQTT
z2m.description: Hive Local looks up your Hive receivers in Zigbee2MQTT. Change the base topic only if you've changed it in Zigbee2MQTT.

device.title: Choose receiver
device.description: These are the Hive receivers Zigbee2MQTT knows about. Hot water is offered automatically on receivers that have it.

zha.title: Choose receiver
zha.description: Pick the Hive receiver (SLR1, SLR2 or OTR1) from your ZHA devices. Hot water is offered automatically on receivers that have it.

error.no_bridge: Zigbee2MQTT didn't send its device list. Check that MQTT is set up, Zigbee2MQTT is running, and the base topic is right.
error.no_receivers: Zigbee2MQTT has no Hive receivers that aren't already added.
error.not_hive: That device has no Thermostat cluster, or ZHA hasn't finished loading it. Pick the receiver (SLR or OTR), not the wall thermostat.

abort.no_zha: ZHA isn't set up in Home Assistant.

boost_heating.name: Boost heating
boost_heating.description: Heat to a temperature for a number of minutes, then go back to the previous mode.

device_id.name: Receiver
device_id.description: Which receiver. Can be left out if you only have one.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to boost (1-360). Defaults to the boost duration setting.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature (5-32 °C). Defaults to the heating boost temperature setting.

boost_water.name: Boost hot water
boost_water.description: Turn the hot water on for a number of minutes.

device_id.name: Receiver
device_id.description: Which receiver. Can be left out if you only have one.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to boost (1-360). Defaults to the boost duration setting.

cancel_boost_heating.name: Cancel heating boost
cancel_boost_heating.description: End a heating boost and go back to the previous mode.

device_id.name: Receiver
device_id.description: Which receiver. Can be left out if you only have one.

cancel_boost_water.name: Cancel hot water boost
cancel_boost_water.description: End a hot water boost and go back to the previous mode.

device_id.name: Receiver
device_id.description: Which receiver. Can be left out if you only have one.

set_holiday.name: Set holiday
set_holiday.description: Hold frost protection until a date and time (hot water off), then go back to the previous mode.

device_id.name: Receiver
device_id.description: Which receiver. Leave out for every receiver.

until.name: Until
until.description: When the holiday ends. Without a time zone it's Home Assistant's local time.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Heating temperature while away (5-32 °C). Defaults to the heating frost protection setting.

cancel_holiday.name: Cancel holiday
cancel_holiday.description: End a holiday now and go back to the previous mode.

device_id.name: Receiver
device_id.description: Which receiver. Leave out for every receiver.

test_timed_hold.name: Test a timed hold
test_timed_hold.description: Temporary test for the holiday fail-safe: holds the heating for a few minutes with a hold duration and reports in a notification whether the receiver ended it by itself.

device_id.name: Receiver
device_id.description: Which receiver. Can be left out if you only have one.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Temperature to hold during the test.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long the hold should last (2-60).
